benefits.name: Emotional wellbeing
benefits.details: Adobe offers programs to help you handle everyday challenges, build resilience, and reduce stress.

benefits.name: Mental health care
benefits.details: If you or a family member is coping with anxiety, depression, grief, substance use, an eating disorder, or other mental health need, your Adobe benefits can help.

benefits.name: Financial wellbeing
benefits.details:
Financial wellbeing program 
401(k) retirement plan
Employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
Life insurance
Deferred compensation plan
Financial coaching and resources

benefits.name: Support in times of need
benefits.details: Life is full of unexpected—and sometimes difficult—events, which can be overwhelming. The good news is that Adobe has a lot of benefits that can help. But sorting through them could be overwhelming too!

benefits.name: Wellbeing reimbursement program
benefits.details: We want to help you and your family boost your physical, mental and financial well being. To support you in this effort, Adobe will reimburse you up to $600 per year for eligible services and activities that directly relate to these three well-being pillars.
